testCommand: pwsh -NoProfile -Command '$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"; $failed = 0; foreach ($test in @("./new-project/tests/e2e-registration-commit-test.ps1", "./new-project/tests/e2e-registration-unreachable-test.ps1", "./new-project/tests/e2e-dotnet-cli.ps1")) { try { & $test } catch { $failed = 1; Write-Error $_ } }; exit $failed'
rationale: The contract drives the real scaffold dispatcher through a reachable-source fixture, an unreachable-source fixture, and the existing end-to-end verification. It checks that registration files are committed before setup creates the initial commit, that unavailable registration is non-blocking and reported, and that the established scaffold and stamp checks still pass while registration is attempted.
